name: AIトリアージ提案の表示動作を項目別に設定する一覧
prompt:
Create one static UI screenshot of only the supplied Linear settings crop, matching its exact 825x585 px bounds and 1.41:1 aspect ratio. Use a pure white background, compact neutral styling, soft fine borders, restrained radius, and clean baseline alignment. Preserve the same hierarchy, card size, row spacing, icon positions, menu positions, and generous horizontal space from the reference. Use crisp, readable Japanese UI type with restrained weights; keep labels on one line.

Show only the "Behavior" section, localized to Japanese: heading 「動作」 and supporting line 「提案の表示、非表示、自動適用のルールを定義します」. Do not include the left navigation, the Triage Intelligence page title or description, the enable switch, Workspace guidance, or any content outside this crop.

Inside one wide rounded white card, show exactly six full-width settings rows, in this order, with thin horizontal separators: 「担当者を提案」, 「プロジェクトを提案」, 「ラベルを提案」, 「チームを提案」, 「重複する課題を提案」, 「関連する課題を提案」. Each row has a compact pale-gray icon tile on the left with a simple slate outline glyph matching the entity (people, project cube, tag, team badge, duplicate overlapping squares, related issue). At the right, place the same small outlined pill control in every row: a thin dashed-circle suggestion glyph, the label 「表示」, and a small down chevron. Keep all six rows and all controls completely inside the card with visible bottom padding.

Use dark, legible neutral gray for labels and slightly softer gray for the supporting sentence; do not fade text into the background. Keep borders subtle, text unclipped, and icon strokes consistent. Preserve the source's white and gray palette; do not add branding, color accents, gradients, shadows stronger than the reference, extra cards, extra rows, or additional controls. No photography, decorative graphics, charts, or mock browser frame.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against the exact 825x585 source crop using a side-by-side comparison. The Behavior heading/description and all six settings rows remain fully visible in source order. The card bounds, row divisions, icon tiles, and right-side Show controls align closely with the reference; all Japanese labels and six 表示 menus fit on one line. Text is slightly darker than the low-contrast source to keep localized labels legible; icon glyphs are faithful approximations. The raw generated canvas is 1489x1056 (1.410:1) and was proportionally reduced to 825x585 with no aspect distortion.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
